front: What is redis installation in one sentence?
back: Install Redis as a managed service — bind address, auth/ACL, memory cap, and persistence before exposing beyond localhost.

front: Explain the mental model of redis installation (how the system thinks).
back: Default upstream packages expose 6379 with protected-mode if no password and bind not restricted — fine for dev trap, dangerous if firewall wrong.

front: Which standard commands / workflow do you use for redis installation?
back: Package / image ──► redis-server ──► reads redis.conf → curl -fsSL https://packages.redis.io/gpg | sudo gpg --dearmor -o /usr/share/keyrings/redis-archive-keyring.gpg → sudo chmod 644 /usr/share/keyrings/redis-archive-keyring.gpg → echo "deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/redis-archive-keyring.gpg] https://packages.redis.io/deb $(lsb_release -cs) main" \ → sudo apt-get update

front: Given a broken redis installation setup, what is your first validation command?
back: Package / image ──► redis-server ──► reads redis.conf

front: What are the production-safe defaults for redis installation?
back: Typical unit (/lib/systemd/system/redis-server.service):

front: Symptom: Connection refused — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: systemctl status; bind · Fix: Start service; fix bind; firewall

front: Symptom: NOAUTH — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: ACL/requirepass · Fix: Update app URL; ACL LIST

front: Symptom: Starts then exits — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: journalctl -u redis-server · Fix: Bad dir permissions; corrupt AOF → redis-check-aof

front: Symptom: Can't write config — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: CONFIG SET without rewrite · Fix: Edit redis.conf; restart; fix ownership

front: Symptom: OOM on host — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: no maxmemory · Fix: Set cap + eviction policy

front: Symptom: Exposed to internet scan — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Shodan/censys; ss -tlnp · Fix: Firewall; bind localhost; ACL; disable default user

front: Gotcha with redis installation: what silently fails?
back: requirepass in git — config management leaks secrets. Use env-substituted template or secret mount.

front: When should you NOT use redis installation?
back: Multi-master write on open network — use managed Redis / cluster with proper topology. requirepass only on 6+ — migrate to ACL for command-level least privilege. Installing from random PPA — use official redis.io or distro you trust; pin version.

back: Checklist: (1) mental-model constraint, (2) required config/commands, (3) health/triage check, (4) one failure mode to avoid. Anchor: Package / image ──► redis-server ──► reads redis.conf

front: What is redis-cli in one sentence?
back: Interactive + scripted Redis admin — inspect memory, latency, persistence, and live traffic under incident load.

front: Explain the mental model of redis-cli (how the system thinks).
back: One thread executes commands — slow KEYS *, huge SMEMBERS, or Lua loops = latency spike for everyone. Prefer SCAN, MEMORY DOCTOR, SLOWLOG.

front: Which standard commands / workflow do you use for redis-cli?
back: redis-cli ──► TCP/UNIX ──► Redis single-threaded event loop → redis-cli -h 127.0.0.1 -p 6379 → redis-cli -u redis://default:PASSWORD@127.0.0.1:6379/0 # ACL user default → redis-cli --tls --cert ./client.crt --key ./client.key --cacert ./ca.crt → AUTH default yourpassword # legacy; prefer ACL + -u URL

front: Given a broken redis-cli setup, what is your first validation command?
back: redis-cli ──► TCP/UNIX ──► Redis single-threaded event loop

front: What are the production-safe defaults for redis-cli?
back: Memory fields to watch:

front: Symptom: OOM / killed — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: INFO memory; host dmesg · Fix: Set maxmemory + policy; add RAM; delete big keys

front: Symptom: Timeouts app-side — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: LATENCY DOCTOR; SLOWLOG · Fix: Remove KEYS; pipeline; split hot key

front: Symptom: OOM command not allowed — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: maxmemory-policy noeviction · Fix: Change policy or raise limit

front: Symptom: Spike every N minutes — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: INFO persistence rewrite/bgsave · Fix: Disable save during peak; disk tuning; diskless replica

front: Symptom: Replica lag — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: INFO replication offset · Fix: Slow commands on master; network; repl-diskless-sync

front: Symptom: Connections refused — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: INFO stats rejected · Fix: maxclients; file descriptors; connection storm

front: Symptom: Data "vanished" — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Eviction + no TTL · Fix: TTL on cache keys; monitor evicted_keys

front: Symptom: AOF corrupt on boot — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Logs · Fix: redis-check-aof --fix; restore RDB backup

front: Gotcha with redis-cli: what silently fails?
back: **KEYS * in prod** — blocks event loop. Use SCAN or --bigkeys sampling.

front: When should you NOT use redis-cli?
back: Primary source of truth without persistence — enable AOF/RDB or accept loss. Redis as message queue at scale — use dedicated broker; BLPOP patterns hit limits. Large object store — >512MB values hurt; use object storage.
